217009.description:
Based on the erotic game by Jitaku Studio.

Hatsune Nijo’s tastes were thoroughly warped by the influence of a childhood friend’s mother, leaving him with an intense obsession with gyaru (gal) fashion and culture. Years later, Hatsune’s fixation had only deepened—to the point where he began cross-dressing to embody his ideal gyaru persona himself. Then, one day, he received a message from his younger sister, Tsukune Nijo: "Hey, Big Bro! So, my school recently started allowing students to wear casual clothes..." "If you're still into that whole 'gal' thing, why not come to school with me?" There was no curing this twisted obsession of his. So, he decided to simply embrace it and live life on his own terms! With that resolve, Hatsune returned to his hometown and decided to transfer into the school. A new school life begins—one spent alongside gyaru girls who fully accept and celebrate his cross-dressing alter ego!

(Source: Pinkpineapple, translated)

Ra-On can’t stand men, and he’s determined to stay away from them at all costs. Little does he know that the shy, soft-spoken Seo-U is crushing on him hard. So hard, in fact, that he’s recruited his more confident twin brother, Je-U, to act as his double and approach Ra-On. But as Je-U starts putting a little too much of his own heart into the act, the line between who’s courting Ra-On gets blurred. Will the brothers break through Ra-On's hatred of men? And if so, which twin will be the one to win Ra-On's heart?

217070.description:
The second cour of Futsutsuka na Akujo de wa Gozaimasu ga: Suuguu Chouso Torikae Den.

Through the actions of Reirin and Keigetsu, the series of disturbances caused by a curse in the inner court have settled down.
Through their swap, Reirin and Keigetsu learned of each other’s character, and a friendship was budding between the two of them.

Seasons pass, and we are now at early autumn. The location of the ritual where the Crown Prince and the Maidens wish for a bountiful harvest (the Harvest Festival) has been set within the southern lands ruled by the Shu clan. With no consort as guardian, Keigetsu arduously continues with preparations despite feeling the pressure as the host of the Harvest Festival. Meanwhile, Reirin is wholeheartedly supporting Keigetsu while being thrilled about her first royal outing.

However, right upon arrival, an unforeseen accident occurs and the ritual is interrupted. An agitated Keigetsu’s spell runs out of control, and she once again swaps bodies with Reirin. On top of that, among all the confusion, the post-swap Reirin is abducted...!?

Reirin’s two overprotective brothers Kou Keikou and Kou Keishou get involved and the situation heads in an unexpected direction.
Who is the new mastermind who is sneaking up in order to frame Keigetsu...?

The gratifying tale of switched fates brought to you by two girls who are polar opposites—the curtain rises on the second act, "The First Royal Outing" Arc!

(Source: Official Site)

Meanwhile, counterfeit money is discovered at the scene of a murder in Tokyo, prompting the Metropolitan Police Department to establish an investigation headquarters. As the unprecedented circulation of counterfeit new banknotes throws the public into confusion, Conan and Heiji head to Osaka, where the counterfeit money is believed to have been printed.

217459.description:
"Never before had I experienced anything like this—let alone something this intense."

Exhausted by life with an indifferent, selfish husband, Ayaha—having signed up for a "mom-katsu" (sugar dating) site out of mere curiosity—found herself in a one-time, illicit encounter with a man she met there. Realizing how dangerous it was, Ayaha decided to leave that moment in the past, never looking back. But now, that same man stands before her—as her own daughter’s boyfriend.

"No—you’re my daughter’s boyfriend, aren’t you? You need to forget about what happened back then..."

Ayaha tries to pretend it never happened, only to learn that for him, too, that encounter had remained an unforgettable, smoldering memory. The warmth and tenderness she had tried so hard to forget—along with a pleasure so intense it threatened to drown her—something she could never have found with her husband. As the feelings she had kept locked away were drawn back toward him, Ayaha could no longer hide the throbbing, swelling ache deep within her body.

(Source: Getchu, translated)

217604.description:
For plain little Nina, working as a maid in the house of Count Mirkwood is her whole world—until a false accusation has her swept out on the streets. Jobless and with nowhere left to turn, Nina decides to set out on her very first solo journey. But Nina isn't just any maid—she's a supermaid! Her talents quickly prove indispensable to the people she meets during her travels. There's Emily, a mage who can't use magic; Astrid, a brilliant inventor whose experiments never quite work; and Tien, an orphan who can't seem to keep a meal down. Meanwhile, back at the Mirkwood household, things go awry in Nina's absence...

None of them realize it yet, but Nina might just be the answer they've all been searching for. Because when this supermaid is on the job, no mess can stand in her way!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

217629.description:
After being confined to Qingshan Mental Hospital, the gifted young man Chen Ji kills the enemy who killed his parents. He then accidentally travels back in time to the ancient world and becomes an apprentice at the Ning Dynasty Medical Clinic. Involved in a case involving the Secret Service, he becomes a non-staff member of the agency, only to discover he's also a spy for the enemy nation. The story revolves around this dual identity. Trapped in the maelstrom of power, Chen Ji secretly fights for survival, using modern knowledge to deconstruct spiritual cultivation systems and maneuvering to overturn the chessboard. Ultimately, he transforms from pawn to master, wielding the Qingshan Mountains as his blade, vowing to shatter the hypocrisy of heaven!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

"My name is Yang Jian, and by the time you read this, I'll be dead."

Ordinary student Yang Jian is caught up in a bizarre invasion, acquiring parchment from the future and a mysterious eye, becoming a ghost wielder. Yang Jian and his classmates escape the campus, but the crisis is just beginning. In this sinister world, the human world is a prison. The price of peering into darkness is eternal loss amidst endless wonder.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

217656.description:
2283, in a post-nuclear wasteland, Fortress City 021 was controlled by Ark Corporation. Their so-called "Savior Guardians" appeared to protect humanity but secretly conducted human experiments using X chips and manipulated public opinion. Young Han Che witnessed his brother's murder by the false Guardians and unexpectedly awakened the "1307 Source System" within him, gaining superpowers. He joined the Yebushou organization, rebuilt by Guan Shanhu, and fought alongside hacker Tian Xin and engineer Kang Di. Yebushou infiltrated Ark training camps and Ghost Island Prison, exposing a plot to create a superpowered army using experiments and mutants. As Han Che unlocked new abilities and faced formidable enemies like Emperor Angel and Divine-Eye Immortal, he embarked on a path of vengeance, truth, and salvation. However, the hidden AI "Lefu" was plotting to control all human consciousness.

(Source: Youku)

217714.description:
They used to be sworn enemies. Now they’re sworn spouses.

Roshi Saigawa and Ritsuka Nagira were once bitter rivals, each fighting for supremacy within rival organizations of superpowered warriors. Their days were filled with duels, schemes, and a rivalry so fierce it seemed nothing could ever bridge the gap between them. Yet, somehow, the impossible has happened— they’re now happily married!

From bitter enemies to star-crossed lovers, these two have traded their weapons for wedding vows, and their former battles have given way to laughter, love, and the everyday chaos of newlywed life.

But just because they’ve left the battlefield behind doesn’t mean life has gotten easier. Old rivalries resurface, secrets linger, and the lines between love, rivalry, and sheer chaos blur in ways neither of them expected. From laugh-out-loud domestic disasters to heart-melting romantic moments, Roshi and Ritsuka are about to prove that falling in love with your enemy isn’t just possible— it’ s explosive.

Full of humor, heart, and sizzling chemistry, this enemies-to-lovers rom-com will keep you laughing, swooning, and turning pages until the very last!

(Source: One Peace Books)

217716.description:
The story centers around Allen, a boy who is reincarnated and given the cheat power of regeneration from a goddess. Since his ability to treat all sorts of injuries and illnesses has otherwise limited use, he plans to use the power on enslaved girls to bring about an easygoing harem life. However, his cheat power is so overpowered that the enslaved girls are completely cured and he is instantly overwhelmed with a hectic, bountiful harvest and lifestyle. Allen deals with his embarrassment of riches with his modern know-how, but that only makes the enslaved girls even more proficient, leading to commercial prosperity.

(Source: Anime News Network)

217717.description:
Our world is actually falling apart, unbeknownst to most. A bizarre apparatus hiding in the depths of Ueno's Shinobazu Pond, a giant snail clinging onto the Eiffel Tower, a demon lord in the form of a beautiful girl... these and countless other cryptic entities—called "Ends"—are driving us closer to the apocalypse. However, some youngsters decided to reject that fate and secretly took up arms.

They are fighting, not to stop the countdown or to eradicate the threats, but only to delay the inevitable. Why would they choose such a thorny path on their own volition? To make the most out of their youth in this godforsaken world! I, a former cartel slave (and ESPer), have had a pretty shit life so far, to be honest. But maybe here I'll be able to lead a fulfilling school life, at least?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

217785.description:
“Here in Manchuria, the cheapest thing you'll find is a person's life.”

In 1937, Isamu Higata is sent to the Japan-controlled Chinese puppet state of Manchukuo to serve in its standing army. After losing sight in his right eye during battle, he's banished to an agricultural facility where he's constantly abused by the commanding officers. Then, in a dusty corner, he discovers a field of poppies, the raw materials for opium. In order to raise money for his seriously ill mother, Isamu decides to produce the illicit drug—a choice that sends his future and the fate of all Manchuria into directions unknown.

217841.description:
Thousands of years ago, Vampire King Akabara "Red Rose" Strauss lost both his kingdom and his queen. Since humans were unable to kill the queen, they sealed her away, erecting thousands of fake seals so that the king would never find her true location. Despite being pursued by relentless dhampires, Akabara continues to search for his queen to this day…

Akabara's quest takes a sinister turn when an entity called the Black Swan appears. The Black Swan inhabits the body of a young human girl every 50 years, giving her the power to destroy the Vampire King and his queen. With each incarnation the Black Swan grows stronger--will the 49th Black Swan mean the end of Akabara?

(Source: VIZ Media)
